# Amorphix

> Amorphix is a free emulator for MorphOS and AmigaOS 4 on Windows and Linux. It runs on a tuned, speed-optimised build of QEMU 11.1 that emulates a Pegasos II PowerPC computer, installs the operating system hands-free from your own ISO, and renders MorphOS 3D on the host's graphics card.

Amorphix is an independent project by BartT21. It does not include MorphOS or AmigaOS 4: users bring their own licensed copies.

## Key facts

- Emulated machine: Pegasos II (QEMU `pegasos2`), PowerPC G4 CPU with AltiVec
- Guest operating systems: MorphOS 3.x, AmigaOS 4.1 Final Edition (Pegasos II edition)
- Host platforms: Windows (installer) and Linux (AppImage)
- Engine: tuned QEMU 11.1 fork, optimised build (LTO + PGO) with Amorphix-specific patches
- Status: 1.x releases, actively developed

## Features

- Hands-free installation of MorphOS and AmigaOS 4 from the user's ISO, including updates
- Amorphix GPU: host-GPU accelerated 3D for MorphOS (TinyGL calls forwarded to the host graphics card)
- Measured on the same PC: MorphOS 3D up to 2.6x faster than emulating a Radeon 9700 graphics card in QEMU
- Experimental host-GPU 3D for AmigaOS 4 (virtio-gpu, Warp3D / MiniGL)
- Guest Tools: shared folder with the host, clipboard sharing, clock sync
- Restore points, auto-recover after a crash, instant start from a saved state
- VM in a normal desktop window (move, resize, full screen), mouse integration without grabbing
- Keyboard layout choice during installation
- Port forwarding, multiple VMs, second hard disk
- Boot to the MorphOS desktop in about 9 seconds

## Licence

The Amorphix manager, installer and Guest Tools are free for personal use and proprietary. Open-source parts (QEMU with our changes, FFmpeg, BBoot, OpenBIOS, the GPL Warp3D driver part) keep their own licences; their source ships with each release.

AmigaOS is a trademark of Amiga Corporation. MorphOS is a trademark of the MorphOS Development Team. Amorphix is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
